user.title: Connect a Xantrex Freedom X Bluetooth remote
user.description: Experimental read-only monitoring for the Freedom X 2000 12 V remote. Disconnect FXC Control and Bluetooth scanner apps first. Includes AC input/output, LOAD watts, battery voltage, and an inferred power path. Reported battery percentage remains provisional.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot read the remote. Disconnect phone apps and check Bluetooth range, then try again.
error.unsupported_device: The device did not identify as a Xantrex Freedom X Remote.
error.unsupported_payload: The payload differs from the observed 12 V protocol. No sensors were created.

abort.already_configured: This Xantrex remote is already configured.
